# `tfctl profile` reference

Manage profile settings for tfctl.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile <subcommand> [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl profile` command provides subcommands for managing profile settings. Use these commands to configure default organizations, workspaces, and other preferences that apply to all tfctl commands.

## Subcommands

- [`display`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile/display) - Display current profile settings
- [`get`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile/get) - Get a profile setting value
- [`set`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile/set) - Set a profile setting value
- [`unset`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile/unset) - Unset a profile setting value

## Examples

The following command displays all profile settings:

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile display
```

The following command sets the default organization:

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile set organization my-org
```

## Global flags
